part.text:
All changes are in place and scoped correctly.

## Summary

Added Handlebars-based template/layout support to the SSG:

- **`src/templates.ts`** — rewrote as a `TemplateEngine` class: compiles layouts from `templates/layouts/*.hbs`, auto-registers partials from `templates/partials/*.hbs`, and renders `templates/index.hbs` for the site listing. Falls back to built-in default templates if the templates directory/files are absent (keeps zero-config usage working), but throws a clear error if frontmatter names a template with no matching layout.
- **`src/build.ts`** — `buildPage`/`build` now accept an optional `templatesDir` (default `./templates`), read `template` from page frontmatter, and pass it through to the engine.
- **`src/cli.ts`** — added `--templates <dir>` flag (default `./templates`).
- **`src/types.ts`** — `Page` gained a `template` field.
- **`./templates/`** — new project scaffold: `layouts/default.hbs`, `layouts/post.hbs` (example alternate layout), `partials/{header,nav,footer}.hbs`, and `index.hbs`, wired together with `{{{body}}}` and `{{> partial}}`.
- **Tests** — new `tests/templates.test.ts` covers layout selection, partials, error handling, and fallback behavior; `tests/build.test.ts` and `tests/cli.test.ts` gained cases for frontmatter-driven templates, custom `templatesDir`, and the `--templates` CLI flag. All pre-existing tests pass unmodified in behavior (only count/list assertions updated for the new fixture file).

`package.json`/`package-lock.json` updated with the `handlebars` dependency.
